facts.text: London Liverpool Street Station is directly above the hotel.
facts.excerpt: London Liverpool Street Station – Directly above the hotel

facts.text: Liverpool Street station gives access to the Central, Circle, Elizabeth, Hammersmith and City and Metropolitan lines and the London Overground.
facts.excerpt: Access the Central, Circle, Elizabeth, Hammersmith and City and Metropolitan lines, London Overground and TFL rail routes.

facts.text: The two-wing redbrick hotel was built in the late 1800s by the Great Eastern Railway Company and sits on the eastern fringe of the City, London's financial district.
facts.excerpt: Built in the late 1800s by the Great Eastern Railway Company, this two-wing redbrick hotel sits on the eastern fringe of the City (London’s financial district).

facts.text: The hotel's design is a mix of Victorian and modern.
facts.excerpt: Its design is a mix of Victorian and modern

facts.text: The property has a hidden Masonic temple, reached through a heavy studded door and a winding staircase.
facts.excerpt: The property has a hidden Masonic temple on-site, accessed via a heavy studded door and winding staircase.

facts.text: Rooms and suites reflect the hotel's location, history and heritage, where the traditional City meets the artistic vibe of East London.
facts.excerpt: Capturing the hotel’s location, history and heritage, our rooms and suites provide creative spaces where the traditionally conservative city meets the ever-evolving, vibrant artistic vibe of East London.

facts.text: The Andaz Design Suite is by British designer Sir Terence Conran, with interiors inspired by East London's heritage and culture.
facts.excerpt: This extravagant suite, by acclaimed British designer Sir Terence Conran, features over-the-top interiors inspired by East London’s heritage and culture.

facts.text: The Design Suite has Eames and Karuselli chairs, a Savoir bed and a replica of the coffee table Conran designed for his own home.
facts.excerpt: The king bedroom and large lounge space include Eames and Karuselli chairs, a Savoir bed and a replica of the coffee table Conran designed for his own home.

facts.text: Rooms have a complimentary minibar with snacks and non-alcoholic beverages.
facts.excerpt: Complimentary minibar with snacks and nonalcoholic beverages

facts.text: Rooms have Byredo bath amenities.
facts.excerpt: Byredo bath amenities

facts.text: Rooms have yukata robes.
facts.excerpt: Luxurious yukata robes

facts.text: The Deluxe Fitness Equipped king room has a Peloton bike, dumbbells and yoga equipment.
facts.excerpt: Discover ample space to unwind or work out in this generous room featuring a Peloton bike, dumbbells, yoga equipment and more.

facts.text: The Family Room is two interconnected rooms with two bathrooms.
facts.excerpt: Relax with your loved ones in this expansive room with two interconnected rooms. The stylish retreat conveniently offers two oversized bathrooms

facts.text: Family Rooms include an Andaz London colouring kit, teddy bear and chalkboard easel, plus children's robes and slippers.
facts.excerpt: Andaz London colouring kit, teddy bear and chalkboard easel

facts.text: Rake's Cafe Bar is a laid-back cafe by day and a cocktail bar by night, with resident DJs on Thursday, Friday and Saturday evenings.
facts.excerpt: the mood shifts with live sets from our resident DJs every Thursday, Friday, and Saturday evening

facts.text: Miyako serves sushi, sashimi, teriyaki and sake in an intimate, contemporary setting.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy a refined menu of sushi, sashimi, teriyaki, and expertly selected sake in an intimate, contemporary setting

facts.text: Lady Abercorn's Pub & Kitchen is an East London pub inspired by a legendary landlady, serving globally inspired comfort food and craft beers.
facts.excerpt: Inspired by a legendary landlady known for her charm, wit, and worldly adventures, this eclectic East London pub invites guests to discover a menu filled with globally inspired comfort food and craft beers.

facts.text: Eastway Brasserie has an open kitchen and large windows overlooking Liverpool Street.
facts.excerpt: The restaurant stuns with an open kitchen, large windows overlooking Liverpool Street and cozy seating.

facts.text: Pets are welcome, with toys, treats, plush beds and feeding bowls for cats and dogs in the room.
facts.excerpt: Pet-friendly offerings includes toys, treats, plush beds and feeding bowls for both cats and dogs in your room.

facts.text: The historic building has event spaces with modern and classic Victorian interiors.
facts.excerpt: Our historic building offers a unique London wedding spaces with modern and classic Victorian interiors.

facts.text: The hotel has a fitness center.
facts.excerpt: Fitness Center

facts.text: The hotel does not provide on-site parking; paid self parking is available nearby.
facts.excerpt: The hotel doesn’t provide on-site parking.

facts.text: Standard rooms look over the city or the interior gallery.
facts.excerpt: Go on, stretch out in this spacious room overlooking the city or interior gallery.
